reuse.why: Reuses getApproxNumberThreshold, but extends api-models' private getExpectedScheduleAmount copy instead of the shared getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts that every other worst-case site uses.

duplication.why: Adds the approximate-amount rule to a local duplicate of the worst-case logic, deepening the divergence between api-models and getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The worst-case rule belongs in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount; putting it in the API model layer leaves forecast, schedule app, budget templates and UI on the old rule.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the expected-amount helper, its call and a test.

maintainability.why: The rule now differs by call path (API vs everywhere else), so a maintainer must remember two definitions of 'expected amount'.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/api-models.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount extended instead of shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount (used by forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts, schedule-template.ts, SchedulesTable, Balance, mobile pages).

disguised_duplication.where: The local copy pre-exists; the diff adds new logic to it rather than disguising a copy.

one_place.where: Only api-models.ts getExpectedScheduleAmount learns the approximate rule; getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts and all its callers keep treating approximate amounts as exact.
